scope: Combat, collection and crystal-repair quest progress requests the existing coalesced full-character save worker. Scene/entity callbacks do not perform database IO or enqueue one job per kill.

Private quest feedback contains the exact successfully saved character image. Requests arriving during capture or IO retain a later sequence; rejected saves do not confirm progress. Pending-save recovery confirms the latest full character, preserving independent bag and Gold changes.

Quest-menu reads and chronicle discoveries require their own complete saved image before quest/discovery replies. Production persistence-unavailable paths fail closed; existing game-only fixtures without any persistence wiring remain usable.
No automatic quest turn-in, reward increase, new quest entitlement ledger or change to the 15-minute dungeon expiry is introduced.
